Crime & Law · India

Pune Fort Murder: Fiancée and Lover Arrested for Trekker's Death

Police in Pune have arrested a woman and her lover for allegedly pushing her fiancé, a trekker, to his death from Lohagad Fort. Investigators claim the couple plotted the murder because the fiancé was an obstacle to their relationship. The incident, initially appearing to be an accident, has led to charges of murder against the fiancée and her alleged accomplice.
